howto.name: Upload the PDF
howto.text: Select a PDF file up to 500 MB that you want to split into smaller chunks.

howto.name: Set the target chunk size
howto.text: Enter the maximum file size per chunk in megabytes (e.g. 10 MB). The tool will split at page boundaries to stay under the limit.

howto.name: Download the parts
howto.text: Click Split. The server breaks the PDF into parts that respect your size target and delivers them in a ZIP archive.

faq.a: The tool splits at page boundaries to keep each chunk under your target size. It cannot split in the middle of a page, so some chunks may be slightly under the target.

faq.q: What is the minimum chunk size I can set?
faq.a: The minimum is effectively the size of the largest single page. If one page is 5 MB, you cannot create chunks smaller than 5 MB.

faq.q: Is this useful for email attachment limits?
faq.a: Yes. Set the chunk size to your email provider's attachment limit (e.g. 25 MB for Gmail) and each part will be small enough to attach.
